# Skylolerr

> Free, open-source Home Assistant custom integrations by Skylolerr, installed from the Home Assistant Marketplace (built in since Home Assistant 2026.11) or with HACS (Home Assistant 2026.10): Energy Flow Mapper, a visual drag-and-drop editor for the Home Assistant energy dashboard, and Daily Challenge, quantity-based daily goals with streaks. Both need Home Assistant 2026.10.0 or newer, are MIT-licensed and translated into English, German, French and Italian.

Every page exists in English and in German (under /de/). Each project page has requirements, installation steps, screenshots and a FAQ.

## Projects

- [Energy Flow Mapper](https://skylolerr.com/energy-flow-mapper/): Edits Home Assistant's own energy settings in a diagram instead of only displaying them. Assign grid import, grid export, solar, battery, water and gas sources by drag and drop (gas has its own tab with the gas meters), nest child devices under upstream devices ("included in"), see live power and energy per period including untracked consumption, see what the whole home uses (with Home Assistant 2026.11 also assign the home meter), create meters (integral helpers) from power and flow sensors, and keep a backup before every save. Home Assistant's own energy checks (sensor unavailable, wrong unit, negative state …) are marked at the affected block, Home shows how much the devices cover ("72% covered by devices"), the panel suggests where a device belongs from Home Assistant's child devices, and the diagram can be saved as a PNG, optionally with names hidden. Devices can be folded into named, nestable groups that show the sum of their members (display only, they change nothing in the energy settings), and Create sum meter turns a group or chosen sensors into a real Home Assistant sum helper. An unsaved draft survives leaving the panel. Includes a read-only dashboard card for all users. Listed in the Marketplace and in HACS: search for Energy Flow Mapper there, no custom repository needed. A vertical diagram keeps large trees readable (card option orientation: vertical). Repository: https://github.com/Skylolerr/ha-energy-flow-mapper
- [Daily Challenge](https://skylolerr.com/daily-challenge/): Tracks daily amounts such as 20 push-ups or 8 glasses of water, not yes/no habits. Streaks with a choice of rule, target vs. actual over the whole challenge, an optional catch-up mode for yesterday's deficit, a calendar (heatmap) of daily values with corrections in the card, automatic counting from a sensor or a rising counter, milestone events with confetti and device triggers, Assist for voice and chat, an overview card for all challenges, blueprints for reminders, milestones, quick add (button or NFC tag), a weekly summary and Assist, actions to read and correct any day, plain entities and its own dashboard card. Listed in the Marketplace and in HACS: search for Daily Challenge there, no custom repository needed. Repository: https://github.com/Skylolerr/ha-daily-challenge

## Install

- Energy Flow Mapper in the Marketplace or HACS: https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Skylolerr&repository=ha-energy-flow-mapper&category=integration
- Daily Challenge in the Marketplace or HACS: https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Skylolerr&repository=ha-daily-challenge&category=integration
- Without the button, Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer: Settings → Marketplace → search for the project name → Install; the setup starts right away, no restart needed.
- Without the button, Home Assistant 2026.10: HACS → search for the project name → Download → restart Home Assistant.
- Both projects are in the default catalog. The My Home Assistant links above open the Marketplace on 2026.11 or newer and HACS on 2026.10.
